overall_reason: A deliberately unstyled HTML ops sheet (system font, browser-default buttons, bordered tables) with specific, situated content (Harbor and Co, revised PO, dated PR states); it is plain and unfinished, but nothing on it is a model's default look.

findings.where: Urgent table Status column and Pending list, tile 1440-00
findings.evidence: State word and detail are run together with no separator or styling: 'Blocked stale 9 days', 'Waiting pending reply', 'Clear warm', 'Draft Unsent', 'Done Yesterday Intro sent to the Boston plant manager.' They read as garbled phrases rather than a status plus a note.
findings.after: Render the state as a label and the detail as text: "Waiting — pending reply" or a status pill followed by the note.
findings.why: Without the missing badge styling, the status vocabulary collapses into nonsense strings; this is the most visible craft gap on the page.

findings.where: range selector under the stats, tile 1440-00
findings.evidence: '7 days  30 days  Quarter' is plain text with no control styling or selected state; dom-1440 has no buttons for it, so it looks like a range switch but does nothing.
findings.after: Make it a real segmented control (three buttons with aria-pressed), or state the period: "Last 7 days".
findings.why: An unlabelled set of period words reads as a stub left from a layout, not a decision.

strengths: Copy is concrete and operational: 'Harbor has gone quiet after the price change. A short note beats another status meeting.', 'Ask Harbor for the revised PO before Friday.' It fails the rival-name swap in the right way: none of it fits another business.
The campaign tracker carries real, dated state ('upstream #799 closed, not merged (Sat 10/17); VibeRooster fork safe to delete').
No eyebrows, icon tiles, gradients, glow or card kit; nothing decorative to delete.
not_investigated: The floating 'Review required 1/5' chip and the 'Finish your review' form appear to be an injected review widget (vr-hitl classes), not page design; not judged.
Visual polish (hierarchy, spacing, table design) belongs to other lenses; the page states it is a 'before' fixture with basic styling.
